name: Rational.parsePatch() / fromString() / patch()

plannedActions.name: Add Rational.parsePatch(str): string->partial config. 'null'->{isNull:true}, '5'->{numerator:5}, '5/60'->{num:5,denom:60}, '5/60hr'->{num:5,denom:60,units:'hr'}, 'cm'->{units:'cm'} where 'cm' is validated via new Units().abbreviation(str) — throws if not a known unit and not a number
Add Rational.fromString(str, defaultUnits?): calls parsePatch(), fills missing fields from defaults, returns Rational
Add Rational.patch(value): if string call parsePatch() and merge with existing fields; if number update numerator; if plain object merge; if Rational replace
Add tests for all parsePatch() input forms, fromString(), and patch() in test/rational.ts

summary: Add string parsing to Rational. parsePatch(str) returns partial config. fromString() constructs Rational. patch() merges with existing fields. Validates units.
